name: @papercusp/scout-chat
description: Themable, backend-agnostic Scout chat drawer: Vaul panel + @papercusp/drawer-stack registration, streaming transcript + composer over @papercusp/sse resilientPostStream (Last-Event-ID turn resume), @papercusp/chat-protocol interactive cards, ETag/304 transcript restore via @papercusp/data-fetch. All endpoints + session identity stay behind a ChatTransport adapter; all visual identity flows through --sc-* CSS custom properties.
